name: sumTo_eq
prelude:
def sumTo : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => sumTo n + (n + 1)
statement: theorem sumTo_eq (n : Nat) : 2 * sumTo n = n * (n + 1)
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [sumTo, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_mul] at *; omega
  have squares (k : Nat) : sumTo k + sumTo (k + 1) = (k + 1) * (k + 1) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [sumTo] at ih ⊢
      simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at ih ⊢
      omega
  have h := squares n
  simp only [sumTo, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at h ⊢
  omega
strategies: Direct induction on n and expansion of the quadratic.
Prove a consecutive triangular-sums square identity, then recover the target algebraically.
